parameters.name: NewResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the new resource group.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the resource.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of resource.

*   **VpnGateway**: VPN gateway

    After you move a VPN gateway to a new resource group, the following associated resources are also moved to the new resource group: IPsec servers, SSL servers, SSL client certificates, and IPsec-VPN connections.

*   **CustomerGateway**: customer gateway

*   **VpnAttachment**: IPsec-VPN connection

    An IPsec-VPN connection associated with a transit router or not associate with a resource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc move-vpn-resource-group --instance-id vpn-8vb3lzn7biepthri80000 --resource-type VpnGateway --new-resource-group-id rg-acfmzs372yg0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
